name: OTM Lottery Long Call
summary: Buy a very cheap, very far OTM call (delta under 0.10) for a small-probability, large-multiple payoff. Structurally negative expectancy in most regimes - clearly marked as a low-allocation speculation.

legs.strike_rule: Delta 0.03-0.10, or the first strike costing <= $0.30

max_profit: Unlimited in theory; realistically 5x-50x the debit on a violent move
max_loss: Debit paid x 100 - and the base case is a total loss. Expect a win rate under 15%.
breakevens: strike + debit; typically far above spot, which is why most of these expire worthless

greeks.gamma: positive but tiny until the underlying approaches the strike
greeks.theta: negative; percentage decay is brutal - these lose value faster in percent terms than any other long option
greeks.vega: positive, small in dollars; far-OTM calls carry skew premium

when_to_use: Rarely. Only as a deliberate convexity sleeve: a small, capped, recurring allocation where you accept a low hit rate for a fat tail. Not a core strategy.
entry_rules: Hard cap: total open lottery-call debit <= 0.5% of equity (~$250 on $50k) at any time
Only on underlyings with ADV >= 5M shares and OI >= 250 on the chosen strike
Do not enter when IVR > 60 - you are buying the most skew-inflated part of the chain
Log these separately in the P&L so they never contaminate the performance stats of real strategies
management_rules: Take profit at +300% (4x the debit). Do not hold for the theoretical 20x
If the position reaches +300%, sell 75% and let 25% ride to expiry-minus-one-day
No stop loss - the debit is the stop; position size IS the risk control
exit_rules: Sell to close at +300%, or let it expire worthless
If ITM at any point, close by 15:30 ET on expiry day - auto-exercise on a surprise winner would deliver 100 shares
assignment_risk: None (long). Only auto-exercise on the rare winner.
liquidity_needs: Far-OTM markets are frequently 0.01/0.05 wide in percentage terms - you can lose 50% on the spread alone. Require bid > 0 and spread <= $0.05 absolute.
common_mistakes: Sizing these like real positions; treating a lucky winner as evidence the strategy works; buying them the day before earnings when the skew is at its most expensive.
zero_dte_notes: 0DTE far-OTM calls are the purest version of this and the most negative-expectancy trade in the entire bank. If traded at all, treat as a <=0.1% equity flyer with a same-day 15:30 ET hard flatten.
